intent: Embed proactive autonomous user-goal pursuit as deterministic canonical state and bounded control logic without USB, crypto, smart contracts, a second consciousness daemon, or model self-authorization.
architectural_laws: Operational autonomy is a state-machine property, not a model self-description
Durable goal objective is copied from a canonical owner user turn
Retries, steps and effects are hard-budgeted
completion_contracts_v1: verified_effect: same owner/generation/required capability + EffectJournal VERIFIED + outcome ok=true
user_ack: persisted owner user turn from the same canonical session

bounded_local_mechanism_evidence.environment: isolated local Python harness with a minimal fake UnifiedDB API compatible with the controller contract

remaining_promotion_gates: Run committed autonomy tests against exact current canonical UnifiedDB/store.py in authorized isolated full checkout
Fuse autonomy context into the existing retained lifecycle/provider runtime rather than creating a duplicate engine
Drive scheduler ticks from the existing supervisor/re-entry path, not a new daemon
Bind autonomous effect evidence to the exact causal episode/request identity during runtime integration
Adversarially test restart/UNKNOWN effects/dual-user concurrency/prompt injection/context budget
Carry the exact integrated implementation through OCI and required microVM acceptance
